react_int_lesson_1:slide:0.title: React Hooks 🪝
react_int_lesson_1:slide:0.content:
Built-in hooks:
• **useState**: Local state
• **useEffect**: Side effects
• **useContext**: Consume context
• **useRef**: Mutable refs
• **useMemo/useCallback**: Optimization

react_int_lesson_1:slide:1.title: Rules of Hooks 📏
react_int_lesson_1:slide:1.content:
Two rules you MUST follow:

1️⃣ **Only call at top level** - Not inside loops, conditions, or nested functions

2️⃣ **Only call from React functions** - Components or custom hooks

react_int_lesson_1:slide:3.title: Dependency Array ⚙️
react_int_lesson_1:slide:3.content:
Controls when effect runs:

• **[]** - Only on mount
• **[dep]** - When dep changes
• **No array** - Every render (careful!)

Always include all values used inside effect.

react_int_lesson_1:question:0.explanation: Cleanup runs before re-running effect and on unmount.

react_int_lesson_1:question:1.prompt: What does an empty dependency array [] mean?
react_int_lesson_1:question:1.explanation: Empty array means effect runs only once when component mounts.

react_int_lesson_1:question:2.prompt: Can you use hooks inside if statements?
react_int_lesson_1:question:2.explanation: Hooks must be called at the top level to ensure consistent order between renders.

options.react_int_lesson_1:question:2:option:1: No, must be at top level
